liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Saint Of Circumstance** (2 reviews): Reviewer recalls Saint bursting out strongly, along with He's Gone; Reviewer's highlight is the Saint and Looks Like Rain pairing opening the second set [15][18]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer says Sugaree never sounded better [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Not Fade Chant**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-07-06.158833.aud.nak300s.carpenter.flac2448** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 132 min [1]. Said about its sound: Slightly abrupt cut going into Cassidy, with its first couple of notes missing [1]
- **gd1986-07-06.173973.matrix.miksis.thomas.clugston.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience remaster has handclaps removed and pitch corrected; soundboard portion has a few dropouts [7]
- **gd86-07-06.aud.eD.12928.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 132 min; rated 3.47/5 by 17 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found the audience tape, obtained years later, less impressive than remembered [15]
- **gd1986-07-06.fob-senn.adelman-koucky.86521.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [2]

## Around the show

- Field temperature topped 100 degrees; a power hose was used to cool the crowd [13]
- Reviewer says Dylan's opening set was awful, while Petty rescued the day [13]
- Very hot day; reviewer, then 15, nearly fainted during Dylan's long set [15]
- Extreme heat; reviewer thinks heat and a black shirt nearly did in Garcia, who fell into a coma soon after [16]
- Fans danced on the turf under water hoses and in the dust [16]
- Three-act bill with Petty and Dylan; Dylan weak, Petty good; hot and humid [18]
- Reviewer sprayed the crowd with the fire hose and got severe sunburn on the head [19]
- Reviewer's 20th birthday; saw two drummers playing together and a mass of tie-dye on the stadium floor [20]
- Reviewer found the Dead flat through most of the first set [13]
- Reviewer disputes negative opinions, calling it a high-energy show with a strong setlist [17]
- Reviewer calls it an ordinary 1986 show, not as bad as expected before Garcia's mid-decade decline [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-07-06.158833.aud.nak300s.carpenter.flac2448**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Ted Carpenter; source: Nak 300s /w cp4s - TCD5M no Dolby TDK SA90s [1]. Also: Nak 300s audience recording by Carpenter, with patched tape flips and a patched spoken intro [1]
- **gd1986-07-06.173973.matrix.miksis.thomas.clugston.flac1648**: source: Final Cut Pro (16/48) > Izotope RX Advanced > Peak Pro > xAct > FLAC/16 Mixed and Mastered by Brian Miksis August 2025 [7]. Also: Matrix mix: audience cassette masters from Stephen Thomas, circulated by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller, with a soundboard source [7]
- **gd86-07-06.aud.eD.12928.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB-AUD>MC>DAT>CDR [8]
- **gd1986-07-06.fob-senn.adelman-koucky.86521.flac16**: source: FOB Sennheiser 441s > Sony D5 > MAC (TDK MA90s). Taped by B.Koucky, patched from S.Adelman. [2]
